verdict.rationale: Exa provides an official JS SDK with a ready-made `web_search` tool for OpenAI/Anthropic agent loops plus streaming chat-completion-style output, and a documented MCP server integrating with Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, and 10+ AI assistants, satisfying agent-framework tool-call consumption. Structured JSON output_schema support further aids function-calling use cases, though no formal OpenAPI spec was found.
